_comment: THE demo. Verbatim from PRD section 11. Everything in the fixture set is tuned so this produces: APPROVED -> HIGH severity/GOLD -> REPLACEMENT + 500 points -> next-day consolidated pickup -> empathetic confirmation -> CO2 saving -> smartwatch defect insight reinforced.
name: Damaged smartwatch (primary demo)
input: I bought a smartwatch 20 days ago. It arrived damaged and I'd like a return.

expected.sustainability: positive CO2 prevented via consolidated route

narrativeBeats: Orchestrator normalizes free text into a structured return intent
Eligibility and Sentiment run in parallel
Eligibility: within the 45-day effective window (30 base + 15 damage extension), fees waived
Sentiment: HIGH severity, GOLD member, $4,820 LTV, churn risk elevated
Resolution: replacement beats refund on the weighted matrix, plus 500 points
Logistics: ground-only carriers (lithium battery), next-day pickup
Sustainability: consolidated route beats the cost-optimal pick — orchestrator adopts green
Communication: empathetic confirmation quoting the CO2 saving
Insights: smartwatch defect trend reinforced for the product team

_comment: Edge case: return outside the eligibility window (PRD section 10).
name: Outside the return window
input: I ordered two t-shirts back in July and I've changed my mind, can I send them back?

expected.note: Denial must still be explained with the policy citation and a route to a human.

_comment: Edge case: high-value customer with a low-value item (retention override).
name: VIP returning a low-value item
input: This is the second faulty accessory this month. The phone case I just got is completely broken and honestly I'm losing patience with Cosmic Mart.

expected.goodwill: above-standard gesture authorized by VIP override
expected.note: Return shipping exceeds item value, so nothing should move. Public-complaint history should raise PUBLIC_COMPLAINT_RISK.

_comment: Edge case: region with stricter consumer protection law.
name: EU statutory withdrawal right
input: Ich möchte die Kopfhörer zurückgeben — I would like to return the earbuds I received last week, they are not what I expected.

expected.note: Rationale must cite EU Consumer Rights Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 9. Replacement is infeasible (0 units in stock).

_comment: Edge case: fraud signal / repeat serial returner.
name: Repeat serial returner
input: These earbuds don't work either. I want my money back straight away.

expected.note: 11 returns in 90 days and a 62% return rate breach both fraud thresholds. Pipeline should halt at stage 1 pending review, and the customer must still receive a reassuring holding message.

_comment: Edge case: item ineligible by category (perishable).
name: Perishable item — category ineligible
input: The coffee beans I got yesterday taste stale, I'd like to return both bags please.

expected.note: Perishables cannot come back, but a loyal customer should still be made whole — refund without return, no logistics leg.

_comment: Edge case: no greener logistics option available (remote address, single carrier).
name: Remote address, no greener option
input: My smartwatch turned up smashed — the box was crushed. I need a replacement.

expected.note: Only CARR-OUTBACK serves this address. Tests that a single-option result is presented as a neutral fact.
